column1: # Letters' originals (scans) added or changed on R2 after the app was made (read quietly).
# One letter a line: its date (YYYY-MM-DD) and to whom, a TAB, then its pages in order with "|"
# between them ("letters/<year>/<name>.jpg"). "-" alone takes a letter's original away. Two
# letters to the same person that day: "#2" for the second. Upload the pages to prabhupada-media first.
